zoe: Heads-up: midweek playoff watch at the office kitchen. Kickoff 7:45pm. Who's bringing snacks? :popcorn:

matt: i'll bring wings if someone else does chips. also low-key looking for a trade partner for my kicker in fantasy playoffs :grimacing:

claire: wings + chips = sold. matt, you kidding about a kicker trade? we should have standards :laughing:

matt: desperate times. my kicker has been doing okay but bye week chaos. anyone want him for a second-round pick?

claire: i'll take a look but no promises. What's the scoring again?

zoe: Standard scoring + FG >50 yards gets bonus 2 pts. Kicker market is weird this week.

ops-bot: FYI: Office TV reservation confirmed at 7:30pm in kitchen. Capacity: 12. Please follow kitchen cleanup rules after the event.

matt: ok trade pitch: my kicker (2 FGs last week) for a 2nd round draft pick in our playoff consolation bracket. @claire any interest?

claire: Tempting. I'll offer a late 2nd + a bag of chips. Negotiating with my conscience rn :thinking:

zoe: Poll: Who's coming? React :one: Matt, :two: Claire, :three: Both, :four: Neither

giphy-bot: giphy result for "hype sports" : https://giphy.com/gifs/hype-cheer-1g3A8w3R6Qq5G

matt: :one: i'll be there by 7:15

claire: :two: bring those chips if we make the trade, matt. Also, reminder: no plates in the sink, use the dishwasher (label's on the fridge).

zoe: trade note: if a kicker trade happens, both managers must update lineup before 7:30pm cutoff. No exceptions.

matt: agreed. chips + wings trade is on. see you all tonight, and may the best (most strategic) trash-talker win :trophy:

claire: see you! and someone bring napkins for the wings drama :wink:
